segments.arabic:
١١١١٨- خولة بنت مالك:
بن ثعلبة بنت أصرم بن فهر بن ثعلبة بن غنم [بن عوف] «٣» بن عمرو بن عوف، ويقال خولة بنت حكيم «٤» .
ذكرها أبو عمر- بن خليد بن دعلج، عن قتادة، ويقال بنت دليح- ذكره ابن مندة، ويقال خويلة، بالتصغير، بنت خويلد آخره دال. أخرجه ابن مندة، من طريق أبي حمزة الثمالي، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس: وقيل بنت الصامت، أخرجه يحيى الحمّاني في مسندة، من طريق أبي إسحاق السّبيعي، عن يزيد بن زيد، عنها، قال محمد بن إسحاق في رواية يونس بن بكير عنه: وأخرجه أحمد عن يعقوب وسعد ابني إبراهيم بن سعد، عن أمهما، واللفظ له عن ابن إسحاق، عن معمر بن عبد اللَّه بن حنظلة، عن يوسف بن عبد اللَّه بن سلام، عن خولة.
وفي رواية إبراهيم خويلة امرأة أوس بن الصامت، أخي عبادة، قالت: فيّ واللَّه وفي أوس بن الصامت أنزل اللَّه ﷿ صدر سورة المجادلة، قالت: كنت عنده، وكان شيخا
(١) أخرجه البخاري في صحيحة ٤/ ١٠٤. وأحمد في المسند ٦/ ٤١٠، وأورده المتقي الهندي في كنز العمال حديث رقم ١٦٧٥٧.
(٢) أسد الغابة ت ٦٨٨٦، الاستيعاب ت ٣٣٦٦.
(٣) سقط في أ.
(٤) الثقات ٣/ ١١٦، أعلام النساء ١/ ٣٢٦، ٣٢٨، تجريد أسماء الصحابة ٢/ ٢٦٣، تقريب التهذيب ٢/ ٥٩٦، تهذيب الكمال ٣/ ١٦٨٢، تهذيب التهذيب ١٢/ ٤١٦، ٤١٤، خلاصة تهذيب الكمال ٣/ ٣٨٠.
segments.english:
11118—Khawla bint Malik:

ibn Tha'laba bint Asram ibn Fihr ibn Tha'laba ibn Ghanm [ibn 'Awf][3] ibn 'Amr ibn 'Awf. She is also said to be Khawla bint Hakim.[4]

Abu 'Umar mentioned her—Ibn Khulayd ibn Da'laj, from Qatada. She is also said to be bint Dulayh; Ibn Manda mentioned this. She is also said to be Khuwayla—the diminutive—bint Khuwaylid, the latter ending in the letter dal. Ibn Manda transmitted this by way of Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas. She is also said to be bint al-Samit; Yahya al-Himmani transmitted this in his Musnad by way of Abu Ishaq al-Sabi'i, from Yazid ibn Zayd, from her. Muhammad ibn Ishaq said this in Yunus ibn Bukayr's narration from him. Ahmad also transmitted it from Ya'qub and Sa'd, the two sons of Ibrahim ibn Sa'd, from their mother—the wording is his—from Ibn Ishaq, from Ma'mar ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Hanzala, from Yusuf ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Salam, from Khawla.

In Ibrahim's version she is Khuwayla, the wife of Aws ibn al-Samit, the brother of 'Ubada. She said: “By Allah, it was concerning me and Aws ibn al-Samit that Allah—majestic is His glory—revealed the opening of Surat al-Mujadilah. I was with him, and he was an old man—”

[1] al-Bukhari transmitted it in his Sahih, 4/104; Ahmad in Musnad Ahmad, 6/410; and al-Muttaqi al-Hindi included it in Kanz al-'Ummal, hadith no. 16757.

[2] Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6886; al-Isti'ab, entry 3366.

[3] Omitted in A.

[4] al-Thiqat, 3/116; A'lam al-Nisa', 1/326, 328; al-Tajrid, 2/263; Taqrib al-Tahdhib, 2/596; Tahdhib al-Kamal, 3/1682; Tahdhib al-Tahdhib, 12/416, 414; Khulasat Tahdhib al-Kamal, 3/380.

segments.arabic:
كبيرا قد ساء خلقه وضجر، قالت: فدخل عليّ يوما فراجعته بشيء فغضب وقال: أنت عليّ كظهر أمي، ثم خرج فجلس في نادي قومه ساعة ثم دخل عليّ فإذا هو يريدني قالت:
فقلت: كلا والّذي نفسي بيده، لا تخلص إليّ وقد قلت ما قلت حتى يحكم اللَّه ورسوله فينا.
قالت: فواثبني فامتنعت منه فغلبته بما تغلب به المرأة الشيخ الضعيف فألقيته عني، ثم خرجت حتى جئت رسول اللَّه ﷺ فجلست بين يديه، فذكرت له ما لقيت منه. فجعلت أشكو إليه ما ألقى من سوء خلقه، قالت: فجعل رسول اللَّه ﷺ يقول: «يا خويلة، ابن عمّك شيخ كبير فاتّقي اللَّه فيه» .
قالت: فو اللَّه ما برحت حتى نزل فيّ القرآن، فتغشّى رسول اللَّه ﷺ ما كان يتغشاه ثم سرّي عنه، فقال: «يا خويلة، قد أنزل اللَّه فيك وفي صاحبك» . ثم قرأ عليّ: قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِها وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ ... إلى قوله: وَلِلْكافِرِينَ عَذابٌ أَلِيمٌ [المجادلة ١ و٤] .
قالت: فقال رسول اللَّه ﷺ: «مريه فليعتق رقبة» . قالت: فقلت: واللَّه يا رسول اللَّه، ما عنده ما يعتق. قال: «فليصم شهرين متتابعين» . قالت: فقلت: واللَّه إنّه لشيخ كبير ما به من طاقة. قال: «فليطعم ستّين مسكينا وسقا بعذق من تمر» . قالت: فقلت: يا رسول اللَّه، ما ذاك عنده. قالت: فقال رسول اللَّه ﷺ: «فإنّا سنعينك بعذق من تمر» . قالت: فقلت: يا رسول اللَّه، وأنا سأعينه بعذق آخر. فقال: «قد أصبت وأحسنت، فاذهبي فتصدّقي به عنه، ثمّ استوصي بابن عمّك خيرا» . قالت: ففعلت.
وفي رواية محمد بن سلمة عن إسحاق: خولة بنت مالك بن ثعلبة. أخرجه ابن مندة، وكذا أخرجه من طريق جعفر بن الحارث عن ابن إسحاق، وكذا رواه زكريا بن أبي زائدة، عن ابن إسحاق، أخرجه الحسن بن سفيان.
وقال أبو عمر: روينا من وجوه عن عمر بن الخطاب أنه خرج ومعه الناس، فمرّ بعجوز فاستوقفته فوقف، فجعل يحدّثها وتحدثه، فقال له رجل: يا أمير المؤمنين، حبست الناس على هذه العجوز. فقال: ويلك! أتدري من هي؟ هذه امرأة سمع اللَّه شكواها من فوق سبع سماوات، هذه خولة بنت ثعلبة التي أنزل اللَّه فيها: قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِها وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحاوُرَكُما ... [المجادلة ١] الآيات، [واللَّه لو أنها وقفت إلى الليل] ما فارقتها إلا للصلاة ثم أرجع إليها.
قال: وقد روى خليد بن دعلج عن قتادة، قال: خرج عمر من المسجد ومعه الجارود العبديّ فإذا بامرأة برزة على ظهر الطريق، فسلّم عليها عمر، فردت ﵇، فقالت:
segments.english:
He was elderly; his disposition had grown bad, and he had become irritable. She said: One day he came in to me, and I answered him back about something. He became angry and said, “You are to me like my mother's back.” Then he went out and sat for a while in the assembly of his people. Afterward he came in to me, and suddenly he wanted me. She said:

I said, “No, by Him in whose hand is my soul! You shall not have access to me, after saying what you said, until Allah and His Messenger judge between us.”

She said: He sprang upon me, but I resisted him and overcame him as a woman may overcome a feeble old man, and I threw him off me. Then I went out and came to the Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—and sat before him. I told him what I had suffered from him and began complaining to him about the bad temper I had to endure from him. She said: The Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—kept saying, “O Khuwayla, your cousin is an elderly man, so fear Allah concerning him.”

She said: By Allah, I had not yet left when the Qur'an was revealed concerning me. The Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—was enveloped by what used to envelop him; then it lifted from him. He said, “O Khuwayla, Allah has sent down revelation concerning you and your companion.” He then recited to me: “Allah has indeed heard the statement of the woman who disputes with you concerning her husband and complains to Allah …” down to His words, “And for the disbelievers there is a painful punishment” [al-Mujadila 1 and 4].

She said: The Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—said, “Tell him to free a slave.” She said: I replied, “By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, he has nothing with which to free one.” He said, “Then let him fast for two consecutive months.” She said: I replied, “By Allah, he is an elderly man and has no strength for that.” He said, “Then let him feed sixty poor persons—a wasq, with a cluster of dates.” She said: I replied, “O Messenger of Allah, he does not possess that.” She said: The Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—then said, “We shall help you with a cluster of dates.” She said: I replied, “O Messenger of Allah, and I shall help him with another cluster.” He said, “You have done rightly and well. Go and give it in charity on his behalf, and then take good care of your cousin.” She said: And I did so.

In Muhammad ibn Salama's narration from Ibn Ishaq: “Khawla bint Malik ibn Tha'laba.” Ibn Manda transmitted it, and likewise transmitted it by way of Ja'far ibn al-Harith from Ibn Ishaq. Likewise, Zakariyya ibn Abi Za'ida related it from Ibn Ishaq; al-Hasan ibn Sufyan transmitted it.

Abu Umar said: We have related through several chains that Umar ibn al-Khattab went out with the people accompanying him. He passed an old woman who asked him to stop, so he stopped and began speaking with her while she spoke with him. A man said to him, “Commander of the Faithful, you have held up the people for this old woman!” He replied, “Woe to you! Do you know who she is? This is a woman whose complaint Allah heard from above the seven heavens. She is Khawla bint Tha'laba, concerning whom Allah revealed: ‘Allah has indeed heard the statement of the woman who disputes with you concerning her husband and complains to Allah, and Allah hears the conversation between you both …’ [al-Mujadila 1]—and the ensuing verses. [By Allah, had she remained standing until nightfall,] I would not have left her except to perform the prayer, after which I would have returned to her.”

He said: Khulayd ibn Da'laj also related from Qatada, who said: Umar left the mosque with al-Jarud al-Abdi. There was a mature, self-possessed woman out on the road. Umar greeted her, and she returned his greeting and said:

segments.arabic:
هيها يا عمر، عهدتك وأنت تسمي عميرا في سوق عكاظ تروع الصبيان بعصاك، فلم تذهب الأيام حتى سميت عمر، ثم لم تذهب الأيام حتى سميت أمير المؤمنين! فاتق اللَّه في الرعية، واعلم أنه من خاف الوعيد قرب عليه البعيد، ومن خاف الموت خشي الفوت.
فقال الجارود: قد أكثرت على أمير المؤمنين أيتها المرأة. فقال عمر: دعها، أما تعرفها؟ هذه خولة بنت حكيم امرأة عبادة بن الصامت التي سمع اللَّه قولها من فوق سبع سماوات، فعمر أحقّ واللَّه أن يسمع لها.
قال أبو عمر: هكذا في الخبر خولة بنت حكيم امرأة عبادة، وهو وهم- يعني في اسم أبيها وزوجها، وخليد ضعيف سيئ الحفظ.
segments.english:
“Ah, Umar! I knew you when you were called Umayr in the market of Ukaz, frightening children with your staff. Then, before many days had passed, you were called Umar; and then, before many more days had passed, you were called Commander of the Believers! So fear Allah concerning the subjects under your care. Know that, for whoever fears the threatened punishment, what is distant draws near; and whoever fears death fears that the opportunity will pass him by.”

Al-Jarud said, “Woman, you have said a great deal to the Commander of the Believers.” Umar said, “Leave her. Do you not know her? This is Khawla bint Hakim, the wife of Ubada ibn al-Samit, whose words Allah heard from above the seven heavens. By Allah, Umar has all the more right to listen to her.”

Abu Umar said: This is how it appears in the report: “Khawla bint Hakim, the wife of Ubada.” This is an error—meaning in the name of her father and that of her husband. Khulayd was weak and had a poor memory.

unresolved.arabic_span: ذكرها أبو عمر- بن خليد بن دعلج، عن قتادة
unresolved.explanation: The printed Arabic lacks a connective after “Abu 'Umar mentioned her.” None of the supplied witnesses permits the relationship of the following isnad fragment to be reconstructed safely, so the rupture is preserved.
The masculine singular pronoun in “the wording is his” has no securely identifiable antecedent in the canonical construction or the supplied witnesses.

unresolved.arabic_span: قال محمد بن إسحاق في رواية يونس بن بكير عنه
unresolved.explanation: The precise object of “Muhammad ibn Ishaq said” is omitted or textually damaged. “This” preserves the contextual ellipsis without making Ahmad's transmission part of Ibn Ishaq's words.

unresolved.arabic_span: خولة بنت حكيم امرأة عبادة بن الصامت
unresolved.explanation: The report's wording is intentionally preserved because Abu Umar immediately declares it erroneous. Collateral evidence identifies the intended woman as the wife of Aws ibn al-Samit, but her paternal name remains disputed; therefore no corrected identity has been inserted into the translation.
